   - Tax bracket: 15% for income not over $29,600 (§1(b)(i))
   - Tax: 15% × $17,161 = $2,574.15 ≈ $2,574

1. Filing status: Head of household (Bob died in 2014, more than 2 years before 2017, so not surviving spouse)
2. Gross income: $25,561
